### Load require libraries
```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(devtools)
library(magrittr)
```

### Document, install and load the package
```{r}
.libPaths()
document()
install()
load_all()
```

### Load required libraries for the package
```{r}
libs2use <- c("lobstr", "haven", "RSQLite",
              "DBI", "odbc", "R6",
              "RMySQL", "getPass")

use_package("tidyverse", type = "depends")
libs2use %>% purrr::walk(use_package)
```


##### 📦 renv Quick Commands

```{r}
renv::init()        # init project
renv::snapshot()    # save packages
renv::restore()     # restore from lockfile
renv::status()      # check differences
renv::install("pkg")# install package
renv::update()      # update packages
renv::clean()       # remove unused
```
💡 Commit `renv.lock` for reproducibility

##### Test
```{r}
library(ayuda)
db2 <- try2leer("~/data/db/OrangeBook.db")

db2$list()

db2$read("products")

zip <- try2leer("~/data/OrangeBook/EOBZIP_2026_02.zip")

zip$list()

walk(zip$list(), function(x) {
                              zip$read(x, delim = "~") %>% 
                                db$write(x, overwrite = TRUE)})

db$disconnect()
zip$disconnect()

sdtm <- try2leer("~/data/pilot01/sdtm")
sdtm$list()
```
